episode.brief: Prepare the customer migration cutover. Delegate record reconciliation and batch-export implementation to two parallel workers, then integrate their evidence into one auditable release policy and runbook. Preserve unresolved owner authority instead of silently choosing source precedence or failure semantics.

source.adaptation: Combines the full CSV reconciliation corpus with a retry-safe export implementation so one late owner policy governs conflict quarantine and partial delivery.

summary: Reconcile a customer migration and implement its batch exporter in parallel, then establish one policy for disputed records and mixed-validity delivery.
title: Customer migration reconciliation and cutover integrity
